title: Twice as deep
hook: Change depth and predict gauge pressure.
misconception: gauge pressure stays fixed when depth doubles.
objective: Apply ΔP = ρgh to compare gauge pressure when depth changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a static liquid with uniform density and fixed gravity, ΔP = ρgh. When depth doubles, gauge pressure becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔP = ρgh; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a static liquid with uniform density and fixed gravity, with a nonzero initial result. If depth triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on gauge pressure?
recall.why: Apply ΔP = ρgh under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
